spots.line: It smells of tar and old fish and nobody apologises for it.
A slate by the door counts debts. Half the names have been scratched out with a knife.

chests.line: A locker behind the barrels, tallied to a name nobody will say aloud.

people.name: Rell the Pirate Man
chatter: Halbrec keeps the beach. I keep the corner. It works.
Two maces and nowhere left worth taking with them.

people.name: a gull that got in
chatter: Nobody has been able to get it back out since the spring.
